text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...T-Trainer-san... Are you all right?
Um... Doesn't your face look tired...?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, it just finished, so I'm all good now!

text_block_list.text:
After careful deliberation, it took a bit of time,
but I was finally able to put together
the training plan.
choice_data_list: Starting today, we're going to focus on training Speed!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Speed, you say...?
choice_data_list: I tried comparing your running with Ai's.
I compared your running style with Ai's.

text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye is an all-rounder.
She excels in every single attribute.
"Above all, she excels in raw speed—so much so that she can even hold her own at the mile distance."

"Speed is a matter of natural talent—
and Chrono Genesis possesses that talent."

However, right now, she still falls short of Almond Eye. We need to fix that.
There should still be room for growth.

Thanks to Chrono Genesis's forte of sheer toughness,
her current speed had been plenty sufficient, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is held at Tokyo Racecourse, where the track is wide and large strides have the advantage—but my stride isn't particularly large, so..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So that's why the speed...
I see...

And I intend to use high-intensity, efficient
training—the kind that Almond Eye cannot do.
Almond Eye has some physical frailties. I've heard that a single training session leaves her heavily exhausted.
Because of that, it seems difficult for her to undergo high-intensity training for extended periods.
choice_data_list: It's going to be some pretty intense training, though...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine...!
As you know, I'm quite sturdy...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Or rather...
you really believed in me, didn't you...?
That I could handle this plan..."
choice_data_list: Yeah. There are areas where you have the edge over Ai!
Yeah. There are areas where you surpass Ai, too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I have to... go to Ai-san...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still... you're right...!
The numbers definitely say so as well...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm... hopeless, aren't I? Getting so tossed around
by historical data and method results..."
choice_data_list: That's why I'm here to cover for that, aren't I?
That's why I'm here to cover for you, right?

text_block_list.text:
"We make up for what each other lacks.
That's what a three-legged race is all about."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That is true... Fufu,
you're already making better use of the Genesis Method
than I am...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...With you by my side, Trainer, I feel like I can even surpass Ai-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!
choice_data_list: 3 more left, think you can still go?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... No problem at all...!

And so, having built up our training,
we welcomed the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of winning performance Almond Eye will show us today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan cares about the records too, doesn't she?
Like course records, win counts, and all that!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I really hope it becomes a historic moment~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Without a doubt... I'm going to win!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I-Incredible...!
Such a blazing spirit...!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...!
Ai, you're in better shape than ever!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...Ai-san is certainly strong...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Still... with how I am now... I should be able to win...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: You're right... Trainer!
